use_case_name: Copy Uncompressed Files to Another Location

claims.content: Allows users to search and gain access to objects they would like to manage.

goal.raw_text: Allows users to search and gain access to objects they would like to manage.

claims.content: User
The operating system is installed on the computer system.
PeaZip is running and the user has access to the file manager interface.
Files or folders exist in a location accessible via the file manager interface (e.g., local disk, optical drive).
By pressing this particular button, opens a submenu with choices that have to do with altering ways of selection of files displayed currently at file manager interface.

trigger.raw_text: By pressing this particular button, opens a submenu with choices that have to do with altering ways of selection of files displayed currently at file manager interface.

claims.content: User browses computer system's locations via the File Manager Interface to locate files.
User selects desired files using selection options (e.g., 'Select all', 'Invert selection', or by attributes) from the Edit menu.
User initiates copy operation via drag and drop feature or context menu (implied by file management utilities).
System displays graphic display of currently executed functions’ progress window (PeaLauncher) showing input/output sizes and time.
Upon completion, system shows ‘Job successfully completed’ status with option to explore output location or confirm with OK.
The user may use the 'Drag and Drop Feature' to initiate the copy or move operation instead of using context menus.
If the user is browsing inside an archive, they can use keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+F2) to browse the archive root, otherwise it browses the computer's root.
The user can toggle between 'browse mode' and 'flat view mode' to display all objects contained in the current path or in the archive together.
If errors occur during the copy operation, the PeaLauncher window may remain open (based on 'Keep open only if needed' setting) to display error messages.
The user can cancel the operation at any time by pressing the 'Cancel' button in the progress window.
The selected files are successfully copied to the target location.
The PeaLauncher window displays a 'Job successfully completed' status along with details of the input size, output size, and time taken.
The user is presented with options to either explore the new file location or confirm the completion by clicking 'Ok'.
